title: BatchImportReport
description: Machine-readable report printed by the Python importer (stdout, single JSON object) after processing a batch envelope. Data pipelines must branch on 'outcome' rather than exit codes or log scraping.

outcome.description: imported: every result imported; empty: envelope carried zero results; partial: some results imported, some failed; failed: results present but none imported; duplicate: batch_id was already ingested and nothing was re-imported.
